text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: SH-SHE'S DEAD?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I'm walking down the hallway, I hear
ominous
shrieks from somewhere nearby!
I rush over in a
panic, only to find...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Man, who would've thought King's food
was
poisoned?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. We're terribly sorry to have
alarmed you,
but everything is under
control.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It's a murder mystery game, amigo!
King's fine!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They explain that the game involves
solving a
murder case based on the clues
given to each
individual player.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! We don't actually have a GM

yet—that's "game master," by the way.
Would you
mind being ours?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so I find myself game-mastering a
murder.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Let's start with the circumstances
surrounding
our victim. King was found
in the evening,
collapsed in one of the
inn's guest rooms.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
The cause of death seems to be poison
mixed into
a bowl of egg custard served
with dinner. Other
than that, there were
reports of a loud shattering
sound just
before King died.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A fittingly ominous start to a murder
mystery...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Geez, that's horrible... Who would do
such a
thing?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I don't believe we know each other well
enough
to judge that, unfortunately.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Then let's get started by breakin' the
ice! First off,
self-introductions! Ándale!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Shall we begin by detailing our roles,
and what
we've done today?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Um, I'm Special Week and I'm the cook.
Today, I
was toiling away cooking up a
feast for King!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
And I am a waitress who works at the
same inn! I
served King her meal.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hola! I'm a traveling poet staying at the
inn! I got
acquainted with King today, so
I dropped by her
room to hang out after
her meal was served.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Heyyy, I'm a housekeeper at this inn,
and I've
been cleaning all day long.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With everyone's introductions over, I
feel like I've
got a better picture of the
situation now.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Well, well... It seems that everyone is
suspicious.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm, you said it.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Spe could've added the poison while she

prepared the meal, and Grass could've
spiked it
on the way to the room.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Likewise, El could have snuck it in when
she
visited King, and Sei could have
tampered with
things while cleaning.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: No way! I didn't add any poison!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Chillax. This is a game, remember?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah—has anything caught your
attention yet,
Trainer? You can go
ahead and forget about
being the GM
for a minute.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yep, I'm a housekeeper after all. I do try
to stick
to places where there aren't any
guests around,
though.
choice_data_list: Was Seiun Sky cleaning during dinner, too?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: In fact, I barely spend any time around the guests, so I'm not sure why you're suspecting me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky shrugs as she looks over to the

collapsed King Halo. And right then...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wait, the bowl is a different color!
I know I
used a yellow one!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My goodness, you're right. It was yellow
when I
delivered it as well.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
But now it's in a blue bowl. Maybe
someone came
into the room and
swapped the bowls around
after it was
served?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Going by the introductions from earlier,
the only
one who came into the room
after the dish was
served was El Condor
Pasa...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Qué?! Me?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Everyone glances over at her with
accusing eyes.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I know, right? I can't believe there's
poison in
there... And after Sei brought
me such nice
veggies to cook with, too...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It saddens me greatly that such
renowned cuisine
was used as a means
for murder...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Everyone looks over to the collapsed
King Halo
with bowed heads, when...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wait, the bowl is a different color!
I know I
used a yellow one!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My goodness, you're right. It was yellow
when I
delivered it as well.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
But now it's in a blue bowl. Maybe
someone came
into the room and
swapped the bowls around
after it was
served?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Going by the introductions from earlier,
the only
one who came into the room
after the dish was
served was El Condor
Pasa...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Qué?! Me?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Everyone glances over at her with
accusing eyes.
